components.name: Track switch
components.description: Two-segment MVC / Web API switch at the top of the sidebar.
components.css: .ds-track{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid #e8e5f0;border-radius:10px;background:#f8f7fb;font-family:Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif;width:208px}.ds-track a{padding:7px 0;border-radius:7px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#55526a;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .18s}.ds-track a:hover{color:#1b1830}.ds-track a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #512bd4;outline-offset:2px}.ds-track a[aria-current=page]{background:#fff;color:#512bd4;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(27,24,48,.08),0 2px 6px rgba(27,24,48,.06)}
